package onboarding

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain/repository"
)

type handoffWorkerStore struct {
	dispatch, notification                            domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent
	accepted, activePath, delivered, retried, blocked int
	markDeliveredErrors                               []error
}

func (*handoffWorkerStore) Enqueue(context.Context, repository.TeacherOnboardingHandoffEnqueue, time.Time) (domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent, bool, error) {
	return domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, false, nil
}
func (*handoffWorkerStore) GetByStudentState(context.Context, string, domain.TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef, domain.TeacherLearningReadinessGoal) (domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent, bool, error) {
	return domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, false, nil
}
func (store *handoffWorkerStore) ClaimDispatch(_ context.Context, token, worker string, now, until time.Time) (domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent, bool, error) {
	if store.dispatch.ID == "" {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, false, nil
	}
	result := store.dispatch
	store.dispatch = domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}
	result.Status, result.ClaimToken, result.LockedBy, result.LockedUntil, result.Attempts = domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffDispatching, token, worker, until, result.Attempts+1
	return result, true, nil
}
func (store *handoffWorkerStore) RetryDispatch(context.Context, string, string, string, time.Time, time.Time) error {
	store.retried++
	return nil
}
func (store *handoffWorkerStore) MarkAccepted(_ context.Context, _, _ string, _ domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff, _ time.Time) error {
	store.accepted++
	return nil
}
func (store *handoffWorkerStore) ClaimNotification(_ context.Context, token, worker string, now, until time.Time) (domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent, bool, error) {
	if store.notification.ID == "" {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, false, nil
	}
	result := store.notification
	result.Status, result.ClaimToken, result.LockedBy, result.LockedUntil = domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffMessagePending, token, worker, until
	return result, true, nil
}
func (store *handoffWorkerStore) RetryNotification(context.Context, string, string, string, time.Time, time.Time) error {
	store.retried++
	return nil
}
func (store *handoffWorkerStore) MarkDelivered(_ context.Context, _, _, _ string, _ time.Time) error {
	if len(store.markDeliveredErrors) != 0 {
		err := store.markDeliveredErrors[0]
		store.markDeliveredErrors = store.markDeliveredErrors[1:]
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	store.delivered++
	store.notification = domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}
	return nil
}
func (store *handoffWorkerStore) MarkActivePath(context.Context, string, string, time.Time) error {
	store.activePath++
	return nil
}
func (store *handoffWorkerStore) Block(context.Context, string, string, string, time.Time) error {
	store.blocked++
	return nil
}

type handoffWorkerPlanner struct {
	result domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff
	err    error
	calls  int
}

func (planner *handoffWorkerPlanner) CreateOnboardingPlanHandoff(context.Context, domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent) (domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff, error) {
	planner.calls++
	return planner.result, planner.err
}

type handoffWorkerReadiness struct {
	result domain.TeacherLearningReadiness
	err    error
	calls  int
}

func (resolver *handoffWorkerReadiness) ResolveLearningReadiness(context.Context, string, domain.TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef) (domain.TeacherLearningReadiness, error) {
	resolver.calls++
	return resolver.result, resolver.err
}

type handoffWorkerDialog struct {
	messages         map[string]domain.DialogMessage
	calls, mutations int
}

func (dialog *handoffWorkerDialog) AppendTeacherProactive(_ context.Context, binding domain.TeacherDialogBinding, key, body string) (domain.DialogMessage, error) {
	if message, ok := dialog.messages[key]; ok {
		dialog.calls++
		return message, nil
	}
	dialog.calls++
	dialog.mutations++
	message := domain.DialogMessage{ID: domain.DeterministicOnboardingUUID("handoff-message", key), DialogID: binding.ID, AuthorType: domain.DialogMessageAuthorPersonalTeacher,
		Channel: domain.DialogMessageChannelWeb, PersonalTeacherID: binding.PersonalTeacherID, Body: body, Status: 1, Version: 1,
		MessageSequence: 1, LastEventSequence: 1, CreatedAt: time.Date(2026, 9, 11, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)}
	dialog.messages[key] = message
	return message, nil
}
func (dialog *handoffWorkerDialog) AppendTeacherResponse(_ context.Context, request domain.DialogTeacherRequest, key, body string) (domain.DialogMessage, error) {
	if message, ok := dialog.messages[key]; ok {
		dialog.calls++
		return message, nil
	}
	dialog.calls++
	dialog.mutations++
	message := domain.DialogMessage{ID: domain.DeterministicOnboardingUUID("handoff-message", key), DialogID: request.DialogID, AuthorType: domain.DialogMessageAuthorPersonalTeacher,
		Channel: request.SourceChannel, PersonalTeacherID: request.PersonalTeacherID, LearningActionID: request.LearningActionID, ReplyToMessageID: request.SourceMessageID,
		Body: body, Status: 1, Version: 1, MessageSequence: 2, LastEventSequence: 2, CreatedAt: time.Date(2026, 9, 11, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)}
	dialog.messages[key] = message
	return message, nil
}

func TestHandoffWorkerPersistsPlannerAcceptanceBeforeNotification(t *testing.T) {
	intent := workerHandoffIntent(t)
	store := &handoffWorkerStore{dispatch: intent}
	planner := &handoffWorkerPlanner{result: workerHandoffResult(intent)}
	worker := newHandoffWorker(store, planner, &handoffWorkerReadiness{}, &handoffWorkerDialog{messages: map[string]domain.DialogMessage{}})
	claimed, err := worker.ProcessNext(context.Background())
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, claimed)
	require.Equal(t, 1, planner.calls)
	require.Equal(t, 1, store.accepted)
	require.Zero(t, store.delivered)
}

func TestHandoffWorkerPrioritizesAcceptedNotificationOverDispatchBacklog(t *testing.T) {
	dispatch := workerHandoffIntent(t)
	notification := workerHandoffIntent(t)
	notification.ID = "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999"
	notification.Status = domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffAcceptedStatus
	notification.PlannerHandoffID = "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666"
	notification.AcceptedAt = time.Date(2026, 9, 11, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	notification.ReadinessObservedAt = notification.AcceptedAt.Add(-time.Minute)
	store := &handoffWorkerStore{dispatch: dispatch, notification: notification}
	planner := &handoffWorkerPlanner{result: workerHandoffResult(dispatch)}
	dialog := &handoffWorkerDialog{messages: map[string]domain.DialogMessage{}}
	worker := newHandoffWorker(store, planner, &handoffWorkerReadiness{}, dialog)

	claimed, err := worker.ProcessNext(context.Background())
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, claimed)
	require.Zero(t, planner.calls, "a dispatch backlog may not starve accepted notifications and their dense cursors")
	require.Equal(t, 1, dialog.mutations)
	require.Equal(t, 1, store.delivered)
	require.NotEmpty(t, store.dispatch.ID, "the queued dispatch remains eligible for the next drain iteration")
}

func TestHandoffWorkerDoesNotLetContinuousNotificationsStarveDispatch(t *testing.T) {
	dispatch := workerHandoffIntent(t)
	notification := workerHandoffIntent(t)
	notification.ID = "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999"
	notification.Status = domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffAcceptedStatus
	notification.PlannerHandoffID = "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666"
	notification.AcceptedAt = time.Date(2026, 9, 11, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	notification.ReadinessObservedAt = notification.AcceptedAt.Add(-time.Minute)
	store := &handoffWorkerStore{dispatch: dispatch, notification: notification}
	planner := &handoffWorkerPlanner{result: workerHandoffResult(dispatch)}
	worker := newHandoffWorker(store, planner, &handoffWorkerReadiness{}, &handoffWorkerDialog{messages: map[string]domain.DialogMessage{}})

	claimed, err := worker.ProcessNext(context.Background())
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, claimed)
	// A new accepted item arrives before the next drain iteration.
	store.notification = notification
	claimed, err = worker.ProcessNext(context.Background())
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, claimed)
	require.Equal(t, 1, planner.calls)
	require.NotEmpty(t, store.notification.ID)
}

func TestHandoffWorkerDialogReplayAfterLocalCrashIsExactlyOneMutation(t *testing.T) {
	intent := workerHandoffIntent(t)
	intent.Status = domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffAcceptedStatus
	intent.PlannerHandoffID = "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666"
	intent.AcceptedAt = time.Date(2026, 9, 11, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	intent.ReadinessObservedAt = intent.AcceptedAt.Add(-time.Minute)
	store := &handoffWorkerStore{notification: intent, markDeliveredErrors: []error{errors.New("crash after Dialog commit"), nil}}
	dialog := &handoffWorkerDialog{messages: map[string]domain.DialogMessage{}}
	worker := newHandoffWorker(store, &handoffWorkerPlanner{}, &handoffWorkerReadiness{}, dialog)
	claimed, err := worker.ProcessNext(context.Background())
	require.True(t, claimed)
	require.Error(t, err)
	claimed, err = worker.ProcessNext(context.Background())
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, claimed)
	require.Equal(t, 2, dialog.calls)
	require.Equal(t, 1, dialog.mutations)
	require.Equal(t, 1, store.delivered)
	for _, message := range dialog.messages {
		require.Contains(t, message.Body, "Подготовка ещё не началась")
		require.Contains(t, message.Body, "не созданы")
	}
}

func TestHandoffWorkerReconcilesActivePathWithoutPlannerMutation(t *testing.T) {
	intent := workerHandoffIntent(t)
	store := &handoffWorkerStore{dispatch: intent}
	readiness := &handoffWorkerReadiness{result: domain.TeacherLearningReadiness{Schema: domain.TeacherLearningReadinessSchema,
		Result: domain.TeacherLearningReadinessNotReady, ReasonCodes: []string{domain.TeacherReadinessReasonActivePathExists}, ResolverVersion: domain.TeacherLearningReadinessResolver,
		StateRef: intent.StateRef, ReadinessScope: domain.TeacherLearningReadinessScope, ContentStatus: domain.TeacherLearningContentNotCreated,
		ActivePath: &domain.TeacherLearningReadinessActivePath{LearningPathID: "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777", Version: 1, CourseID: "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888", GoalCode: "programming.foundation", Status: "ACTIVE"}}}
	planner := &handoffWorkerPlanner{err: domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffActivePath}
	worker := newHandoffWorker(store, planner, readiness, &handoffWorkerDialog{messages: map[string]domain.DialogMessage{}})
	claimed, err := worker.ProcessNext(context.Background())
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, claimed)
	require.Equal(t, 1, readiness.calls)
	require.Equal(t, 1, store.activePath)
	require.Zero(t, store.accepted)
}

func TestHandoffWorkerRetriesOperationalAndBlocksInvalidOrHashConflict(t *testing.T) {
	for _, testCase := range []struct {
		name         string
		failure      error
		retry, block int
	}{
		{name: "5xx timeout", failure: domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffUnavailable, retry: 1},
		{name: "malformed", failure: domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffInvalidResponse, block: 1},
		{name: "idempotency conflict", failure: domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffConflict, block: 1},
		{name: "422", failure: domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffRejected, block: 1},
	} {
		t.Run(testCase.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			store := &handoffWorkerStore{dispatch: workerHandoffIntent(t)}
			worker := newHandoffWorker(store, &handoffWorkerPlanner{err: testCase.failure}, &handoffWorkerReadiness{}, &handoffWorkerDialog{messages: map[string]domain.DialogMessage{}})
			claimed, err := worker.ProcessNext(context.Background())
			require.True(t, claimed)
			require.Error(t, err)
			require.Equal(t, testCase.retry, store.retried)
			require.Equal(t, testCase.block, store.blocked)
		})
	}
}

func newHandoffWorker(store repository.TeacherOnboardingHandoffStore, planner repository.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoffGateway, readiness repository.TeacherLearningReadinessResolver, dialog *handoffWorkerDialog) HandoffWorker {
	return HandoffWorker{Store: store, Planner: planner, Readiness: readiness, Responses: dialog, Proactive: dialog, IDs: &testIDs{},
		Clock: &testClock{now: time.Date(2026, 9, 11, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)}, WorkerID: "handoff-worker", LeaseTTL: time.Minute,
		RetryBaseDelay: time.Second, RetryMaxDelay: time.Minute, MaxAttempts: 20}
}

func workerHandoffIntent(t *testing.T) domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent {
	t.Helper()
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 11, 9, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	readiness := domain.TeacherLearningReadiness{Schema: domain.TeacherLearningReadinessSchema, Result: domain.TeacherLearningReadinessReady,
		ReasonCodes: []string{domain.TeacherReadinessReasonFoundationGraphResolved}, ResolverVersion: domain.TeacherLearningReadinessResolver,
		StateRef: domain.TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef{Kind: domain.TeacherReadinessStateDraft, Version: 4}, ReadinessScope: domain.TeacherLearningReadinessScope,
		ContentStatus: domain.TeacherLearningContentNotCreated, Goal: &domain.TeacherLearningReadinessGoal{Code: domain.TeacherFoundationGoalCode, Version: domain.TeacherFoundationGoalVersion, GraphVersion: domain.TeacherFoundationGraphVersion}}
	intent, err := domain.BuildTeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent(domain.PersonalTeacher{ID: testTeacherID, StudentID: testStudentID},
		domain.TeacherDialogBinding{ID: testDialogID, StudentID: testStudentID, PersonalTeacherID: testTeacherID, ContextType: domain.LearningContextGeneral}, readiness, "ru", "", "", now)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	return intent
}

func workerHandoffResult(intent domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent) domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff {
	return domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff{Schema: domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoffSchema, HandoffID: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666",
		Status: domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffAccepted, StateRef: intent.StateRef, Goal: intent.Goal,
		ExecutionStatus: domain.TeacherOnboardingExecutionNotStarted, ContentStatus: domain.TeacherLearningContentNotCreated,
		ReadinessObservedAt: "2026-09-11T09:59:00Z"}
}
